request.question: What drove NVIDIA data center revenue growth in the FY2025 10-K?

response.answer: Data center revenue increased primarily from demand for compute products used in generative AI and accelerated computing workloads [1]. This growth was driven by demand from large cloud service providers, consumer internet companies, enterprise software customers, and sovereign AI programs [1]. Networking revenue also increased as customers built larger AI clusters requiring high-speed interconnects [1]. Gross margin expanded due to a higher mix of data center products and improved pricing on accelerated computing platforms [2].
key_points: Data center revenue growth was driven by demand for compute products in generative AI and accelerated computing [1].
Growth was supported by a diverse customer base including cloud service providers, internet companies, and sovereign AI programs [1].
Networking revenue increased due to the development of larger AI clusters [1].
Gross margin expansion was due to a higher data center product mix and improved pricing [2].
